_doc: Hand-authored unlock ladder (src/progression/unlocks.ts). Requirements: BN achievement ids (public/data/achievements.json) or lifetime stats (src/progression/profile.ts). Grants are choices, never bonuses. Validated by tests/progression.test.ts.

unlocks.name: Evacuee
unlocks.pitch: You made it to an evac shelter. Nobody else did.
unlocks.tradeoff: No skills, no weapon: a pocket knife, a lighter and a bag.

unlocks.name: Convict
unlocks.pitch: The Cataclysm opened your cell. Start in town with a glass shiv.
unlocks.tradeoff: Prison stripes, no bag, no lighter, and the town is full of them.

unlocks.name: Security Guard
unlocks.pitch: A baton, a flashlight and a pistol you've never fired in anger.
unlocks.tradeoff: Fifteen rounds, and every shot rings the dinner bell.

unlocks.name: Fast Food Cook
unlocks.pitch: You know your way around a kitchen, and a steak knife.
unlocks.tradeoff: Cooking skill instead of a bag: carry less from day one.

unlocks.name: Handy Man
unlocks.pitch: A tool belt, a hammer and a nail gun: build your way out.
unlocks.tradeoff: Heavy tools, no food, no fighting skill.

unlocks.name: Missed the evacuation
unlocks.pitch: Start in a house in town: loot is close, so are the dead.
unlocks.tradeoff: No shelter, no locker of supplies, zombies next door.

unlocks.name: Police Officer
unlocks.pitch: A small-town deputy with a .45, a taser and a radio.
unlocks.tradeoff: Guns are loud. The badge won't impress anyone any more.

unlocks.name: Firefighter
unlocks.pitch: Bunker gear and a halligan bar: doors are a suggestion.
unlocks.tradeoff: Heavy, hot turnout gear; no food, no bag.

unlocks.name: Home Mechanic
unlocks.pitch: Wrench, screwdrivers and a welder: every wreck is a parts store.
unlocks.tradeoff: Mechanics skill, not fighting skill.

unlocks.name: Library Nerd
unlocks.pitch: You grabbed the library's return box. Reading is learning.
unlocks.tradeoff: A box of books is heavy, and books don't stop teeth.

unlocks.name: Medical Resident
unlocks.pitch: A deluxe first aid kit and the know-how to use it.
unlocks.tradeoff: Dress shoes and a lab coat are not armor.

unlocks.name: Bow Hunter
unlocks.pitch: Start in the woods with a compound bow and a hunting knife.
unlocks.tradeoff: Quiet but slow to learn; far from any town's loot.

unlocks.name: Wilderness
unlocks.pitch: Start among the trees: few zombies, fewer supplies.
unlocks.tradeoff: No building, no loot nearby, and nights are dark and cold.

unlocks.name: Lab Patient
unlocks.pitch: Wake in an experiment cell deep under a science lab, the staff long gone.
unlocks.tradeoff: Locked in four or more floors down with whatever they left behind, and nothing in your pockets.

unlocks.name: Lab Staff
unlocks.pitch: Left behind in the lockdown: start in the lab's holding cells and find a way up.
unlocks.tradeoff: Deep underground, far from food, with the lab's experiments between you and the surface.

unlocks.name: Title: the Unlucky
unlocks.pitch: For those who keep coming back.

unlocks.name: Camper
unlocks.pitch: A hiking pack, a hatchet and a mess kit, out in the woods.
unlocks.tradeoff: Built for the trail, not for a fight in town.

unlocks.name: Lab Technician
unlocks.pitch: Computers, electronics and chemistry at level 4.
unlocks.tradeoff: A lab coat and safety glasses; no weapon at all.

unlocks.name: Hitchhiker

requirement.hint: Walk a marathon (42.2 km, over any number of lives)

unlocks.pitch: A bathrobe, slippers, a guidebook and, crucially, a towel.
unlocks.tradeoff: Don't panic.

unlocks.name: National Guard
unlocks.pitch: Called up on your day off: a full go-bag and gym shorts.
unlocks.tradeoff: The go-bag is survival kit, not firepower.

unlocks.name: Survivalist
unlocks.pitch: You prepared for this. Survival 6, and a very big knife.
unlocks.tradeoff: Alone in the wilderness, a long walk from anything.

unlocks.name: Title: the Undertaker
unlocks.pitch: A hundred of them put back in the ground.

unlocks.name: Custom survivor
unlocks.pitch: The full character creator: every profession, trait and stat.
unlocks.tradeoff: Point-buy: every advantage costs something.
